1. EARLY/ADVANCE VOTING (IN-PERSON, NO EXCUSE)
BULLOCH COUNTY ANNEX ELECTION OFFICE
OCTOBER 13th – OCTOBER 30th | MON-FRI FROM 8:00 A.M. – 5:00 P.M.
113 North Main Street, Suite 201, Statesboro, GA 30458
Will include TWO SATURDAYS - OCT 17th and OCT 24th
from 9:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.
*** During the early/advance voting timeframe, there will be two
satellite sites available:
Georgia Southern University (GSU) – 85 Georgia Ave.
October 20 – 22 from 8:00 A.M. – 5:00 P.M.
Brooklet City Hall – 104 Church Street
October 26 – October 30 from 8:00 A.M. – 5:00 P.M.
2. MAIL-OUT ABSENTEE BALLOT
Voters can complete an Application for an Absentee Ballot. Once we
receive it, we can mail your ballot to the address requested, outside of
Bulloch County or to the address where you are currently registered to vote
within the county (or alternate address for physically disabled voter). The
deadline to request an Absentee Ballot is OCTOBER 23rd.
3. ELECTION DAY
This will occur at your voting precinct on NOVEMBER 3rd from 7:00 AM to
7:00 PM.
